s.n: Green Place garden veg with whipped feta
s.note: the Green Place of Many Mothers where Furiosa grew up
s.how: Blitz 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt, 2 tbsp olive oil, the zest and juice of half a lemon and a handful each of mint and dill until smooth and green flecked. Spread into a bowl and drizzle with oil. Trim 1 bunch radishes and 1 bunch baby carrots, string 150g snow peas and cut 1 cucumber into spears. Soak the vegetables in iced water 10 minutes, drain and arrange around the dip.

s.n: Bullet Farm chorizo with smoky honey
s.note: the Bullet Farm, all smoke and noise
s.how: Slice 4 chorizo sausages (about 500g) into 1.5cm coins. Heat a heavy pan over high heat and fry without oil for 4 minutes, turning, until blistered and the fat runs. Add 2 tbsp honey, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tbsp sherry vinegar and toss for 1 minute until sticky. Grill 8 slices of sourdough until charred. Serve the chorizo on toothpicks with the bread to mop up the pan juices.

m.note: the long haul across the Wasteland
m.how: Marinate 12 lamb chops for 1 hour with 2 sprigs chopped rosemary, 3 garlic cloves, the juice of 1 lemon and 3 tbsp oil. Grill over high heat 3 minutes a side. Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes alongside and brush with butter.

w.note: the peach seed Furiosa carries all the way
w.how: Halve and stone 4 peaches. Brush the cut sides with a little oil and grill cut side down for 4 minutes until charred and soft. Drizzle with 2 tbsp honey warmed with thyme and serve with 500ml vanilla ice cream.

d.note: the precious milk stored in the Citadel
d.how: Chill 4 tall glasses. Blend 500g vanilla ice cream, 400ml cold milk, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 2 tbsp honey until thick and smooth. Drizzle a little honey down the inside of each glass, pour in the shake and sprinkle with 1 tbsp more malt powder. Serve straight away with straws.
